title: Cookie panel covers half the phone screen on arrival
what_happened: Before I'd read anything, a big cookie box covered the bottom half of the screen, along with the "Get Involved" button behind it. At least it was clear and let me reject everything.
expected: A smaller banner that doesn't hide the main buttons.

title: Home page story ticker rotates by itself every few seconds
what_happened: The strip under the hero buttons changes by itself every few seconds (New / Bulletin / How We're Born / Where We're Born / Reyna...). I couldn't read one before it switched, and the page kept shifting while I tried to tap (several taps were refused because "the page changed").
expected: A strip that stays still until I swipe it, or at least a pause button, so I can read one story and tap reliably.

title: Home headline and Travel card answered my questions plainly
what_happened: The home page headline named the programs (health, housing, youth) and the countries right away. Two scrolls into Get Involved, the first card was Travel: join a scheduled trip or organize one for a group. No email or account was needed. (Small mismatch: the home page says Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic and the United States, while Get Involved only says Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic.)
expected: This is what I hoped for. The country list could match on both pages.
